fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spews a gob of ooze in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
fields.description2: A field of ooze is created in its wake for 3 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
